name: Searing Power raises Flare Bolt's spell power scaling by 20% (#1370)
contract: #1370: Searing Power 680959 reads 'Increases the spell power scaling of Flare Bolt by 20%.' Its exiles effect is Add % Modifier 20; the Flare Bolt chain 800790 -> 502011-502019 carries the module coefficient 0.571 (PyromancerCoefficients) applied in pyromancer_scaling ModifySpellEffectBaseValue, which the DBC modifier never touches. The fix multiplies that coefficient by 1.2 while the caster holds 680959, so with the talent the spell power term is 0.571 x 1.2 = 0.6852 of spell power. spell_effect_value returns SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue for the caster including the module hook. Drink Fel Infusion 44505 supplies the spell power. The term is isolated with relative_to and ratio_to, so the assertion holds at any spell power the fixture grants.

steps.label: Flare Bolt effect value with no spell power
The fixture grants fire spell power
Spell power added to Flare Bolt's value (0.571 coefficient) before Searing Power
Flare Bolt's spell power term is present
Searing Power raises Flare Bolt's spell power term by 20% (0.571 -> 0.6852)
